ex.s: Gong Bao Chicken (also known as Kung Pao Chicken) was originally a family dish of Ding Baozhen, or Ding Gongbao, a high-ranking court official of the Qing Dynasty who helped reconstruct the Dujiangyan Irrigation System in Chengdu, Sichuan.
ex.t: 宫保鸡丁（又名Kung Pao Chicken）原本是丁宝桢（又名丁宫保）的家常菜，他是清朝的一位高级官员，曾帮助重建四川成都的都江堰水利工程。

ex.s: Probably one of the most beneficial innovations is drip irrigation, which has made it possible to develop big, green farms in the middle of the desert.
ex.t: 也许最有价值的创新之一是滴灌，它使得在沙漠中央开发大型绿色农场成为可能。

ex.s: While there have been experiments in different places in the past to make drip irrigation a reality, it is in the Middle Eastern country of Israel that drip irrigation has become a modern success.
ex.t: 虽然过去在不同地方有过实验尝试实现滴灌，但滴灌真正成为现代成功案例的地方是在中东国家以色列。

ex.s: How Simcha Blass, a scientist, discovered this new way of irrigation is rather interesting.
ex.t: 科学家辛查·布拉斯如何发现这种新的灌溉方式相当有趣。

ex.s: This irrigation method uses far less water than other methods.
ex.t: 这种灌溉方法比其他方法使用的水少得多。
